prose: StarSkirmish Bench measures how strong a StarCraft bot each LLM can write in one hour of wall-clock time. Version 0.2 adds flagship models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta, each run in its own lab's CLI harness, scored by win rate against human-written and demo bots.
highlights: Benchmark: LLMs write StarCraft bots in one hour.
Scored by win rate against competitive bots.
